verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm offering professional legal services, not a software product with a user-facing interface, so a built-in AI assistant to delegate tasks to is a category error for this kind of offering. The firm's stated adoption of AI/ML legaltech, such as AI contract review, is internal practice tooling. Nothing in the evidence shows an assistant that clients can operate, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
